In the HeightsBuilding Transport & Installation Guide

How each set building is rigged, tipped, moved and installed. Scan the QR code on the set to reach this page, tap any drawing to zoom in, and follow the steps in order.

Section 1 · Set buildings

Before any move

  • Rig for a balanced load. Find the heavy side first and plan the pick points around it.
  • Use fixed connections (O-ring pipe clamps). Choked spansets can slide along pipes.
  • Guard against kick-out when tipping: safeties on the sides and crew footing the base.
  • Assign a signal person to clear the route and talk to the operator. Tarp loads in weather.
More sections coming. This guide grows as each scenic element gets its own transport and install procedure.
